abilities.name: Stimpack
abilities.text: This Unit suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2). This Unit gains BUFF Speed (3). Additionally, its Perdition Flamethrower and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (3).

abilities.name: Fire it Up
abilities.text: When this Unit makes a Ranged Attack with its Perdition Flamethrower, you may choose 1 model in this Unit to attack using a Flamer Template (FT) instead of rolling its regular Rate of Attack (RoA). If this Unit's Current Supply Value is 2, you may choose up to 2 models to attack using Flamer Templates instead.

upgrades.name: Incinerator Gauntlets
upgrades.text: Set a Fire Wall token Within 4″ in an unoccupied space. If a Unit's Leading Model's path of travel passes through this token, or if any model in a Unit ends either a Move, Deploy, Run, Charge, Disengage, or Close Ranks action, or is Set Within 1″ of this token, remove the Fire Wall token from the battlefield before executing that move. If you do, that Unit suffers HITS 5 (1). If that Unit performed a Charge action, it cannot resolve the IMPACT effect.

upgrades.name: Need A Light?
upgrades.text: When this Unit makes a Close Combat Attack with its Flame Strike, you may choose 1 model in this Unit to attack using a Flamer Template (FT) instead of rolling its regular Rate of Attack (RoA).
